title: South Korea's KOSPI crashes around 11% due to heavy selling of chipmaking stocks
summary: The South Korean stock market experienced a significant crash, with the KOSPI index falling 11% on Tuesday. The crash was triggered by heavy selling of chipmaking stocks, which were also affected by concerns over China's competition in the AI trade. The Kospi index was paused temporarily due to the sudden drop. Asian shares also slipped as investors reacted to the news.
summary_points: The KOSPI index fell 11% on Tuesday
Heavy selling of chipmaking stocks contributed to the crash
Concerns over China's competition in AI trade affected the market
Trading was paused temporarily due to the sudden drop
